name: Hallowed Scroll
summary: In Deathknell, the Hallowed Scroll calls newly risen Forsaken priests to the chapel. Shadow Priest Sarvis gives the summons, sending each novice to Dark Cleric Duesten to learn how the Forsaken wield faith after death.

sections.title: A Summons in Deathknell
sections.body: Newly awakened undead stagger from Deathknell’s graves, their minds reeling from plague, death, and freedom from the Lich King's grip. For those who followed the Holy Light in life, death leaves deep confusion. As fledgling undead fight the mindless Scourge at the settlement’s edge, Shadow Priest Sarvis receives messages. A summons marked by Dark Cleric Duesten calls newly risen priests away from their wandering and into the desecrated town chapel.

sections.title: Faith Redefined
sections.body: At the chapel, Dark Cleric Duesten teaches a harsh faith. He says the Holy Light abandoned the Forsaken in death, ancestral spirits are hollow tales, and demons have no care for their plight. Forsaken clergy teach that willpower and self-reliance are their only sources of salvation. Under Duesten’s guidance, newly risen priests learn to wield divine discipline and shadow through conviction in their own survival, not devotion to distant gods.

faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis gives newly risen Forsaken priests in Deathknell a sealed document. It sends them to Dark Cleric Duesten in the town chapel for priestly training.

faq.q: Who sends the scroll to the player?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Duesten marks the scroll with his seal, and Shadow Priest Sarvis hands it to you in Deathknell.

faq.q: Can Forsaken still wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Duesten tells new priests that the Holy Light no longer concerns them. Forsaken priests turn from traditional devotion to the Light and rely on themselves and their command of Shadow.

faq.q: Where is Dark Cleric Duesten located?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Duesten is inside the ruined church at the center of Deathknell in western Tirisfal Glades, near other Forsaken trainers.

faq.q: Why does Duesten dismiss ancestors and demons?
faq.answer: Duesten wants newly raised undead to cast aside their illusions. He says the Light no longer concerns them, their forefathers’ spirits are fairy tales, and creatures of the Nether do not want them; the Forsaken survived through will alone.

faq.q: What happens after reading the scroll?
faq.answer: You read the parchment and present yourself to Dark Cleric Duesten in the Deathknell chapel. He becomes your trainer there and teaches your first priest abilities.

angles.text: As a priest, you enter the Forsaken faith through self-reliance, suffering, and shadow magic rather than traditional piety.
As an undead, you know the Forsaken have severed ties to their old human faiths and survive through iron will and mutual need.
